text: Every proposal takes half a day. Rate cards, scope, chasing approval by text. And in the rush, a twelve percent discount takes the margin from thirty-nine to thirty.
So we built Proposal and Quote Agent.
It reads the brief and pulls out every requirement, with the line it came from.
It prices the work from your rate card in seconds.
Move the discount, and the margin moves with it. Below the floor, it goes to the partner. Above it, it's ready to send.
And once it's sent, the price is locked.
Proposals out in minutes, at a price someone with authority chose.
The discount is a decision. Never a slip.
